Museums around the Philippines

By Alexis Pabello

Every October, the Philippines celebrates Museums and Galleries Month (MGM), which was established through Presidential Proclamation No. 798, s. 1991, signed by former President Corazon C. Aquino. This 2026, the celebration carries the theme “Bridging Divides, Preserving the Present for Tomorrow.”

With the year almost over, maybe it's time to try something different. Instead of spending another weekend at the mall or staying home, why not visit a museum? You might find something that catches your interest, learn a bit of history, or simply enjoy being somewhere new. If you're up for it, here are ten museums from Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao that you can visit before the year ends.
